insights.one_liner: Norwegian certification and classification body with Dutch roles mainly in Arnhem; most jobs here don't need Dutch.

culture.text: An international certification body and classification society headquartered in Norway, with about 12,000 staff in 2019.
Dutch roles sit mostly in Arnhem (3 of 5), plus Amsterdam and Rotterdam, across healthcare, engineering, sales and compliance.
One team, Digital System Operations, has about 55 people in 5 countries working on digitalising power grids.

open.text: 60% of its 5 jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers.
Not found as an IND recognised sponsor under this name.

growth.text: Revenue was NOK 21.551 billion in 2019 with about 12,000 employees.

worth_knowing.text: Owned by the Det Norske Veritas Foundation rather than listed shareholders.
